scope_note: Format evolves across several vintages. EARLY/pre-regime era (2012-08..2014-05) record types: D(w640), H(w774, discontinued; 2012-08..2012-12 only), S(w69), V(w774); plus HDR./END. control rows whose position-19 char is 'M' (see control_record_types). Regime change at 2014-07 introduces the modern M/U/V/W/X sections; widths then grow by trailing appends (D 640->747@2015-04->755@2020-05; U 320@2014-07->344@2015-04; W 1213@2014-07->1345@2015-04->1537@2017-12; V 774-early->780@2014-07; X from 2016-01). For the NON-PREFIX early vintages (D w640 thru 2015-03, V w774, U w320, W w1213 -- where as_of_date sits at the record end, not the modern middle position) only the 5 pool-key fields are mapped and the remainder is an `early_unmapped_tail` string (decode null); their modern field sets are bounded to the vintage where the modern positions align. Early S is a clean prefix of modern S so it uses the modern field set. Narrower modern vintages (D 747, W 1345) are clean prefixes handled by tolerated trailing over-claim.
